description: This file defines a class `RelationshipObjectHelper` responsible for generating relationship response objects for a JSON API, specifically for relationships associated with a SugarBean object, including building links for related resources.

classes.name: RelationshipObjectHelper
classes.description: Helper class for constructing relationship response objects in the JSON API, utilizing relationship data from SugarBean objects.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the helper with a VarDefHelper instance.

methods.name: getRelationships
